messages:
sam: Follow-up from P-318 (kv-cache oscillation). Need owners, short deadlines, and concrete runbook edits for triage/escalation. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/p-318

lia: I can take the runbook and playbook edits. Will add a 3-step checklist for first responders and paste exact commands. Plan PR by Wed AM.

omar: I'll own config tuning and canary. Steps: reproduce in staging Tues, config PR Thu, canary next Tue.

toni: Monitoring/alerts: add two thresholds on cache_eviction_rate: WARN -> slack notify; SEV -> page SRE + Dedicated lead. If SEV fires 3x in 10 days, auto-create follow-up ticket. I'll file alert PR by Wed.

oncall-bot: Oncall: SRE @lia today. Paging policy: 5m -> escalate.

lia: Draft triage snippet to add under "cache-eviction":

```
# show eviction metric
kubectl exec -it $(kubectl get pods -l app=kv-cache -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- sh -c "curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9090/metrics | grep cache_eviction_rate"

# temporarily increase cache entries and restart
kubectl patch cm cache-config -p '{"data":{"max_entries":"220000"}}' && kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache
```

sam: Agreed owners & timeline:
- omar: staging repro Tue, config PR Thu, canary next Tue
- lia: runbook PR Wed AM
- toni: alerts PR Wed

sam: I'll schedule a weekly 30m sync until actions are closed. Please react :white_check_mark: when you accept. I'll close when PR links are posted.
